entities.summary: Susanna Majuri (b. 1978-11-24, Järvenpää) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Järvenpää and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, painters & sculptors, europe.
